methodology: Tests whether the meta-learner exploits source identity rather than sensor fusion. Test 1: trains on 5-dim 'which expert dominates' feature only. Test 2: permutes entropy and margin values across samples, retrains. Test 3: shuffles labels (sanity check, expect ~33%). Test 4: uses only 15 base probability dims, no entropy/margin/global stats. Bootstrap CI: n=1000, seed=42.

results.source_id_interpretation: If source-indicator F1 (0.7469) ~= full model F1 (0.8800), source identity explains the result. Gap = +0.1332.
results.entropy_margin_interpretation: If permuted-entropy model F1 (0.8938) ~= full model F1 (0.8800), entropy/margin add no signal beyond base probs. Gap = -0.0138.
results.entropy_margin_contribution: Adding entropy/margin/global stats (15->32 dims) changes F1 by -0.0186.

verdicts.source_id_hypothesis: REFUTED: source ID alone is insufficient; meta-features carry additional signal.
verdicts.entropy_margin_hypothesis: CONFIRMED: entropy/margin add no signal beyond base probs.
